name: TMBench
intro: ToM-Bench是一个系统的、自动化的、原创的双语心智理论（ToM）基准，旨在评估大型语言模型（LLM）的ToM能力。它包含一个涵盖8个任务和31个社会认知能力的评估框架，采用多项选择题格式以支持自动化和无偏见的评估，并从头开始构建双语清单以避免数据泄漏。
build_method: 心理学能力分类, 从零人工编题, 三人交叉质检, GPT-4翻译后人工核验
scale: 2860道中英双语选择题，8个任务，31项能力
build_method_en: Psychology taxonomy, original human-authored items, three-author cross-checking, GPT-4 translation with human review
intro_en: ToM-Bench is a systematic, automated, and original bilingual Theory of Mind (ToM) benchmark designed to evaluate the ToM capabilities of large language models (LLMs). It features an evaluation framework covering 8 tasks and 31 social cognitive abilities, uses multiple-choice questions to enable automated and unbiased assessment, and is built from scratch with a bilingual checklist to prevent data leakage.
scale_en: 2,860 bilingual multiple-choice questions, 8 tasks, and 31 abilities

drawio_review_note: Aligned with TMBench arXiv:2402.15052, Sections 3-4 and Appendix B; official zhchen18/ToMBench repository. TMBench adapts the ATOMS theory-of-mind taxonomy by removing visual and mixed abilities, leaving six dimensions and 31 social-cognitive abilities. Eight established psychology tasks cover 19 abilities; authors trained by psychologists create 2,470 original items for those tasks and add 20 items for each of the remaining 12 abilities, yielding 2,860 multiple-choice questions. Stories, questions, correct answers, and plausible distractors are written from scratch. Two rounds of cross-checking and a third-worker adjudication reach 99.4-percent agreement. Chinese originals are translated to English by GPT-4 without answer access and manually checked. Models answer binary or four-way choices, and accuracy is reported by task and by ability.
